# Set Union

![Set Union function icon](../../../../assets/function-icons/functions/collection/set/10-union.svg)

[Collection functions](../index.md) · [All functions](../../index.md)

Returns values in either Set, once each, with the same complete element type and common order. Search also accepts Set Union.vim; no .vim loader is used.
